nodes.name: Intuit Webhook
nodes.notes: Register this node's PRODUCTION URL in the Intuit Developer Dashboard → Webhooks, subscribed to the Payment entity only. Intuit requires a 2xx within ~3s, so we respond immediately and process afterwards.

nodes.name: Fetch QBO Payment
nodes.notes: Uses the existing QuickBooks OAuth2 credential. For an Intuit SANDBOX company use https://sandbox-quickbooks.api.intuit.com instead.

nodes.name: POST to ERPNext
nodes.notes: Guest + HMAC endpoint — no ERPNext API key needed. Body must be sent as the exact signed string (specifyBody=string), not re-serialized JSON.

nodes.name: Send Alert (replace with Slack/Email)
nodes.notes: Swap this for a Slack or Send Email node using {{ $json.subject }} / {{ $json.text }}. Also attach an Error Workflow to this workflow for transient QBO/ERPNext outages.
